significance: A goddess temple at North Paravur in Ernakulam district whose sanctum stands within a lotus pool, with subsidiary shrines to Ganapathy, Kartikeya, Vishnu, Hanuman and others. It is best known for Navaratri, when a music festival is held and children are initiated into letters at the Vidyarambham on Vijayadashami.
story: The ruler of Paravur, who travelled each year to the Mookambika temple at Kollur, is said to have been told by the goddess in a dream to make her image near his palace so that he could see her daily.
